outcome: Hospitalization in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 20,756 pregnant women in the Autonomous Province of Trento (Northern Italy) between 2015 and 2019
finding: Maternal excess weight and obesity were associated with an increased risk of various adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders, cesarean section, macrosomia, and neonatal resuscitation.
